title: Transport of the orientation ξN along the graph chart (parent step 6)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, N ⊆ ℝ^P, ξN : ℝ^P → Λ_{n+1}(ℝ^P) an orientation of N (IsOrientation (n+1) N ξN), x ∈ ℝ^P, and ι : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P a linear isometry with ξN(x)(α) = α(ιe_0, …, ιe_n) for every (n+1)-covector α (e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1). Let δ > 0 and u : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P with u(0) = 0, Du(0) = 0, u of class C¹ on D := ball(0, δ), ⟨ιw, u(v)⟩ = 0 for all v ∈ D and w ∈ ℝ^{n+1}, and x + ιv + u(v) ∈ N for all v ∈ D. Then for every v ∈ D and every (n+1)-covector α, ξN(x + ιv + u(v))(α)·J(v) = α(a_0(v), …, a_n(v)), where a_i(v) := ιe_i + Du(v)e_i and J(v) := √det(⟨a_i(v), a_j(v)⟩)_{i,j}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (ξN : Euclid P → MultiVector P (n + 1)) (x : Euclid P) (ι : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (u : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (δ : ℝ), IsOrientation (n + 1) N ξN → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (n + 1), ξN x α = α (fun i => ι (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))) → 0 < δ → u 0 = 0 → fderiv ℝ u 0 = 0 → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 δ) → (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ, ∀ w : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (ι w) (u v) = 0) → (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ, x + ι v + u v ∈ N) → ∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (n + 1), ξN (x + ι v + u v) α * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (n + 1) => inner ℝ (ι (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) + fderiv ℝ u v (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (ι (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) + fderiv ℝ u v (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))) = α (fun i => ι (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) + fderiv ℝ u v (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))
